A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the MMRF model is a powerful tool to characterize the statistical property of an image and can be effectively employed to restore the missing blocks in an observed image.
the MMRF model provides us a powerful tool to model the spatial correlation in image data.
the multiscale Markov model is capable of providing an accurate estimation of the missing blocks in a corrupted image.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, by modeling the image as an MMRF, the proposed algorithm can be used to interpolate the missing data in a way that preserves the spatial correlation and the local structure in the image.
the proposed MMRF model can be easily extended to other error concealment problems.
